resources.string: Requires disclosure acceptance — tap to review
When the Hotspot Gateway is enabled, this Android device will act as a network router for devices connected to its Wi-Fi hotspot.

Network traffic from connected devices (phones, laptops, smart TVs) will be forwarded through RNET\'s encrypted multi-path transport to the configured server endpoint. Connected devices do not need any additional software.

Non-identifying traffic statistics (byte counts, latency, connected device count) are logged locally on this device for bandwidth management and are not transmitted to any third party. No content of communications is inspected.
You can disable the Gateway at any time using the toggle on the main screen. All routing will stop immediately when you do so.
RNET will forward your network traffic through the nearby device "%1$s", which has an active internet connection. All traffic remains encrypted end-to-end. You can stop this at any time.
RNET will allow nearby devices in the local mesh cluster to route their traffic through this device\'s internet connection. All relayed traffic is encrypted. You can disable this at any time.
No traffic content is inspected. Only aggregate byte counts and latency are logged locally for bandwidth management.
